title: Technician Bench Note — Mobility Equipment Battery Sets with Earlier Warranty Battery Work
content:
# Battery Sets with Earlier Warranty Battery Work — Mobility Equipment

**Rule.** On a warranty battery-set replacement of a Mobility Equipment chair, the battery-set allowance claimed from the manufacturer depends on the chair's service history. When the history already holds a battery repair job posted under the manufacturer's warranty and the latest such posting is no more than 30 days before the day the claim is posted, the allowance is the standard battery-set allowance doubled, to pay for a full charging-system diagnosis; when it is more than 30 but no more than 180 days before, the allowance is the standard battery-set allowance plus one unit; when there is no such posting, or it is older than 180 days, the standard battery-set allowance applies unchanged.

## What the service history must show

The earlier posting is a repair job in the chair's service history with the battery as the component repaired and the manufacturer's warranty as the party bearing the cost. Where there are several, the latest by job date is used. The days run from that job's date to the day the present claim is posted.

## Tiers

| Latest warranty battery job, days before the posting day | Battery-set allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | the standard battery-set allowance doubled |
| 31 to 180 | the standard battery-set allowance plus one unit |
| more than 180, or no such job | the standard battery-set allowance, unchanged |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Latest warranty battery job on 1 May, claim posted on 31 May: 30 days, so the allowance is doubled.
- Same job, claim posted on 1 June: 31 days, so the allowance is the standard allowance plus one unit.
- A job 180 days before the posting day still gives plus one unit; at 181 days the standard allowance applies unchanged.
- A history with battery work recorded only as patient paid or billed to a payer holds no warranty battery job, so the standard allowance applies unchanged.
